name: Pritha Chakraborty

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Pritha Chakraborty is a poet, translator and English teacher associated with Maulana Azad College, Kolkata. Her academic work includes research on Gloria Naylor and African American fiction, alongside interests in gender, environment and postcolonial literature. She has translated Rabindranath Tagore’s story ‘Atithi’ into English.

Her poems here linger at the boundary between remembering and forgetting. ‘Gray is not the Warmest Colour’ lets a monsoon evening dissolve into the traces left by absent people. ‘Lethe’ approaches the same uncertainty through myth, a flowing tide and a boat whose departure remains a question.
